info.name: Gets all people in the given account.

params.name: accountId
params.description: The Account ID

params.name: relativeDate
params.description: Optional paramater used to calculate date based properties. If not provided, it is set to today's date in UTC.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset for pagination

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results in this page

params.name: email
params.description: Filter user with email

params.name: state
params.description:
If specified and not 'Unknown', only include people matching the given state. The available values are defined as follows:
- Unknown: By default, includes only Active people.
- Active: include only Active people
- Deactivated: include only Deactivated people
- All: include all people, regardless of state

params.name: ids
params.description: Optional paramater of comma delimited ids for filtering results based on the person IDs provided

params.name: uniqueId
params.description: Optional paramater of unique identifier for filtering results based on the person unique identifier provided

items.docs:
NOTE: If there are more persons in the account than were returned, there will be a "query-has-more" header that will be set to true.

info.name: Gets the number of days until each person in this account is available and their availability ranges for the duration

params.name: accountId
params.description: The Account ID

params.name: relativeDate
params.description: Optional paramater used to calculate date based properties. If not provided, it is set to today's date in UTC.

params.name: start
params.description: Start date to filter availabilities from (default today UTC)

params.name: end
params.description: End date to filter availabilities to (default 10 years from today UTC)

params.name: boundRange
params.description: Setting this value to true will truncate the dates returned to the specified start and end date paramters

params.name: ids
params.description: Optional paramater of comma delimited ids for filtering results based on the person IDs provided

params.name: includeUnavailable
params.description:
If this is set to true it will return the availabilities and next available dates even if a person doesn't have a next availability.
If the person does not have a "nextAvailableDate", then the "availableInDays" property will be -1
